shots.title: Bump package and bundled Codex plugin manifest to 1.59.0

hazards.description: `slope version recommend` undercalled the release as patch because squash commit subjects hid feature-level human-surface work; #550 was raised and triaged into S153.

shots.notes: Used `node scripts/version-bump.mjs 1.59.0` to update package.json and the bundled Codex plugin manifest together.

shots.title: Open and merge release PR #549 after CI passes
shots.notes: Opened PR #549, watched ci, CodeQL, Analyze (actions), Analyze (javascript-typescript), and GitGuardian pass, then squash-merged the release bump to main.

shots.title: Publish GitHub release v1.59.0 and verify npm latest
shots.notes: Created GitHub release v1.59.0, watched Publish to npm run 27173837982 pass, and verified `npm view @slope-dev/slope version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org` returned 1.59.0.

conditions.description: npm publication is handled by the GitHub Release to npm trusted-publishing workflow; no direct local `npm publish` command belongs in the release sprint.
The release recommendation tool only saw squash commit subjects and therefore recommended patch despite feature-level shipped user surface.

training.description: Release version recommendations need durable SLOPE context, not only unreleased commit subjects.
training.outcome: #550 was opened and triaged into S153 so the recommender can account for roadmap, sprint, or PR evidence when squash merges hide feature-level work.

training.description: The release cycle should verify the GitHub/npm integration instead of trying to publish locally.
training.outcome: PR #549 CI passed, GitHub release v1.59.0 triggered Publish to npm, and npm latest now reports 1.59.0.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm typecheck` passed locally before PR creation.
`corepack pnpm build` passed locally before PR creation.
`corepack pnpm test` passed locally: 235 files passed, 1 skipped; 3667 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate` passed with only existing historical ticket-count warnings before the release bump PR.
`node dist/cli/index.js map --check` reported the codebase map current before the release bump PR.
PR #549 checks passed: ci, CodeQL, Analyze (actions), Analyze (javascript-typescript), and GitGuardian.
Publish to npm run 27173837982 completed successfully and npm registry latest is 1.59.0.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Clean and pleasantly boring in the important places: version bump, CI, release workflow, and registry verification all lined up.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Trust the GitHub Release trusted-publishing path for publication, but double-check semver intent when squash commits hide the shape of shipped work.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The release recommender could undercall a minor release even though the roadmap and sprint history made the user-facing change clear.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S153 can make the release assistant smarter so the next version bump needs less human override.

bunker_locations: `slope version recommend` can undercall semver when it only inspects squash commit subjects.
Release scorecards should record the GitHub release workflow run and npm registry verification as the publication proof.
Post-release roadmap closeout must update phase status when all member sprints are complete.
yardage_book_updates: #550 is triaged into S153 for semver recommendation evidence hardening.
